title: Aromatic Indian Squid Dosa
description: A winey, juicy pescatarian dosa filled with tender squid, aromatic spices, and a splash of white wine for depth.
instructions: Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat and lightly oil it with 1 tbsp.
Pour a thin ladleful of dosa batter onto the skillet and swirl to create an even, thin circle; cook until the edges lift and the underside is golden brown, about 2 minutes.
Flip the dosa gently and cook for another 30 seconds, then remove and set aside on a plate.
In the same skillet, add the remaining 1 tbsp oil and heat until shimmering.
Add the finely minced garlic‑ginger mixture and sauté until fragrant, about 30 seconds.
Toss in the sliced onion and cook until translucent, about 2 minutes.
Stir in the diced tomato and sliced green chili; cook until the tomato softens, about 3 minutes.
Add the squid strips and cook until they turn opaque, about 4 minutes, then deglaze the pan with 1/4 cup white wine, scraping up any browned bits.
Reduce the wine slightly, then stir in the yogurt, salt, and black pepper, cooking for 1 minute until the sauce thickens.
Spoon the filling onto the cooked dosa, fold it over, and serve immediately.
